# AEOCheck

> Free AI search readiness audit tools. Start with a free AEO scan, then choose a $19 Fix Pack or $99 human-reviewed audit when you need implementation help.

## Tools

- [LLMs.txt Checker](https://aeocheck.xyz/tools/llms-txt-checker): Check if your site has a valid LLMs.txt file. Get a technical readiness report.
- [LLMs.txt Generator](https://aeocheck.xyz/tools/llms-txt-generator): Generate an LLMs.txt file from your sitemap or manual input.
- [AEO Checker](https://aeocheck.xyz/tools/aeo-checker): Audit technical answer engine optimization readiness, structured data, trust signals, and AI crawler access.
- [Query Fan-Out Tool](https://aeocheck.xyz/tools/query-fan-out-tool): Simulate related sub-queries, intent clusters, headings, FAQs, and content gaps.
- [AI Crawler Checker](https://aeocheck.xyz/tools/ai-crawler-checker): Check GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, robots.txt, sitemap, and AI-readable file access.
- [Robots.txt AI Crawler Checker](https://aeocheck.xyz/tools/robots-txt-ai-crawler-checker): Review robots.txt rules that may block or allow AI crawler access.
- [GEO Audit Tool](https://aeocheck.xyz/tools/geo-audit): Audit generative engine optimization readiness signals across crawlability, schema, content, and trust.
- [AI Overview Readiness Checker](https://aeocheck.xyz/tools/ai-overview-readiness-checker): Check readiness signals for AI-assisted search summaries.
- [ChatGPT Citation Readiness Checker](https://aeocheck.xyz/tools/chatgpt-citation-readiness-checker): Review public citation-readiness signals for AI retrieval systems.
- [Sample AEO Report](https://aeocheck.xyz/sample-aeo-report): Preview the $19 AI Search Readiness Fix Pack before running an audit.
- [Manual AI Search Readiness Audit](https://aeocheck.xyz/ai-search-audit): Order a $99 human-reviewed fix plan for one important SaaS page.

## Decision pages

- [Is the AI Search Readiness Report Worth It?](https://aeocheck.xyz/compare/ai-search-readiness-report-worth-it): Compare the free scan with the $19 Fix Pack, including deliverables, limitations, good-fit cases, and not-fit cases.

## Guides

- [What Is an LLMs.txt File?](https://aeocheck.xyz/guides/llms-txt-file): Format, examples, and how to create one.
- [Does LLMs.txt Help SEO?](https://aeocheck.xyz/guides/llms-txt-seo): What it can and cannot do for your search visibility.
- [What Is LLMs-full.txt?](https://aeocheck.xyz/guides/llms-full-txt): When to use it and how it differs from LLMs.txt.
- [AEO Audit Guide](https://aeocheck.xyz/guides/aeo-audit): Technical answer engine optimization checklist for crawlability, schema, content, entities, and trust.
- [AI Search Readiness Checklist](https://aeocheck.xyz/guides/ai-search-readiness-checklist): Page-level checklist for crawl access, AI crawler access, LLMs.txt, schema, answer-ready content, and trust signals.
- [Query Fan-Out Guide](https://aeocheck.xyz/guides/query-fan-out): How to plan answer-ready content with simulated sub-queries, intents, FAQs, and content gaps.

## Blog

- [AI Crawlers and Search Readiness](https://aeocheck.xyz/blog/ai-crawlers-search-readiness): How GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot, and other AI crawlers interact with robots.txt and AI-readable files.
- [AI Search vs SEO](https://aeocheck.xyz/blog/ai-search-vs-seo): How AI search visibility differs from traditional search optimization.
- [AEO vs SEO](https://aeocheck.xyz/blog/aeo-vs-seo): The practical difference between answer engine optimization and SEO.
- [How to Get Cited by ChatGPT](https://aeocheck.xyz/blog/how-to-get-cited-by-chatgpt): Content, schema, entity, and trust signals that can improve citation readiness.

## Glossary

- [AI Search Readiness Glossary](https://aeocheck.xyz/glossary): Definitions for LLMs.txt, AEO, GEO, AI crawlers, structured data, answer-ready content, trust signals, and related AI search terms.

## Machine-readable indexes

- [Sitemap](https://aeocheck.xyz/sitemap.xml): Complete index of crawlable public tools, guides, blog posts, and glossary pages.
- [Robots.txt](https://aeocheck.xyz/robots.txt): AI crawler access rules for OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google, Common Crawl, Apple, and Meta crawlers.
- [RSS Feed](https://aeocheck.xyz/api/rss.xml): Latest blog updates in RSS format.
